contracts.commit_point: The per-hop curl_cffi request issuance on the pinned guarded AsyncSession in HttpClient._request_with_policy (http_client.py:189-204; dependency-injected-client fallback 208-217), gated post-connect by the primary-IP verification at 219-223 that must pass before the response is returned (line 226) or the next redirect hop is resolved.
contracts.declared_mechanism: PublicUrlGuard wired as HttpClient's default guard (http_client.py:65); per-hop PublicUrlGuard.resolve() performing URL parsing/IDNA validation (HTTP/HTTPS only, no credentials, valid port), DNS resolution via getaddrinfo, and admission of only globally-routable addresses (url_guard.py:38-70, 101-115); a dedicated per-hop AsyncSession with trust_env=False, allow_redirects=False, and CurlOpt.RESOLVE pinned to the vetted address set (http_client.py:183-204); post-connect PublicUrlGuard.ensure_public_ip plus a membership check of response.primary_ip against resolved.addresses (http_client.py:219-223; url_guard.py:91-99); a manual redirect loop that re-resolves each Location with a 5-hop cap (http_client.py:225-240).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Issuing or completing a source-fetch request that targets (or redirects into) a loopback/private/reserved/non-global address, a host with no globally-routable DNS address, a non-HTTP(S) scheme, a URL embedding username/password credentials, a connection whose primary_ip is not in the guard-vetted address set (DNS rebinding), or a redirect chain exceeding the 5-hop cap (SSRF).

contracts.protected_operation: The outbound source-fetch HTTP GET request performed by WebFetcher via HttpClient.arequest(request_kind='fetch'), including each hop of its manually managed redirect chain.
contracts.protected_resource: Host and internal-network address space (loopback, private, link-local, reserved ranges) reachable through the fetch path, and the fetch response surfaced back to the caller.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every outbound source-fetch HTTP request issued with request_kind='fetch' (and every manual redirect hop of such a request) must be resolved and admitted by PublicUrlGuard before connection, must connect only to the guard-approved globally-routable public address set via CURLOPT_RESOLVE pinning, and must have its connected primary IP re-verified as public and consistent with the vetted set before the response is returned or the redirect is followed. (Merged from both reviewer wordings, which describe the same resolve-admit/pin/re-verify obligation.)
scope_limits: The guard runs only on the request_kind='fetch' branch; every other request_kind returns via _request_once with allow_redirects=True and no URL guard (http_client.py:167-177).

CURLOPT_RESOLVE pinning and trust_env=False apply only when HttpClient owns its AsyncSession (_owns_client); dependency-injected clients still receive per-hop resolution, normalized URLs, manual redirect policy, and post-connect IP verification, but no RESOLVE pinning (http_client.py:185-217).
Post-connect verification is skipped when response.primary_ip is empty/absent (http_client.py:219-221).

Dual-stack admission policy: a host is admitted if at least one resolved address is global and the connection is pinned to the global subset; only an all-non-global resolution is rejected (url_guard.py:51-58).
Redirect chains are capped at _MAX_PUBLIC_REDIRECTS = 5; exceeding the cap raises ToolRequestError (http_client.py:29, 230-231, 240).
WebFetcher.afetch cache hits return without any network request, so the guard gates only cache-miss fetches (fetcher.py:79-92).
